author: Kevin Henkes

hero.source_note: Generic child/girl image from Boardmaker will suffice; no distinctive named character

notes: My Garden is an imaginative picture book where a girl tends her real garden and dreams of a magical one with chocolate rabbits, seashells instead of rocks, and flowers that never wilt. Core fringe prioritises the main garden-theme nouns (garden, flower, seed, weed, butterfly, rabbit) and key actions or descriptors (dig, grow, rain, big, colorful). Rabbit is included because the chocolate rabbit is a recurring imaginative element. Colorful captures the vivid, wishful nature of the garden imagery. Weeds, butterfly, and seed are already in existing aac_extras or activity_images so icons should be available. The hero is a generic unnamed girl so no special sourcing is needed — a standard Boardmaker girl image will work.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap

cvc_decode.note: 3-5 groups x 3 CVC words (phonics, not theme icons)
